purpose: Per-BC-PT judgment label for docs/plan/14-token-economy.md open question 2: whether the record's earns text is fully expressible as one of the four deterministic checks named in docs/plan/03-diagnosis-and-feedback.md (SymPy equivalence, numeric comparison to three decimals, bounds match, units present), given the record also answers no to justification_required, interpretation_required and hypotheses_required.
method: Each of the 76 active data/scoring_points.json records was read against its own earns, does_not_earn, notation_requirements and precision_rules text and against the four checks and the partition rule in docs/plan/03-diagnosis-and-feedback.md. A record that answers yes to any of justification_required, interpretation_required or hypotheses_required is model_required by 03's own partition. A record that answers no to all three is deterministic only when its earns text names one or more mathematical objects, an expression, an equation, an antiderivative, an integrand, a numeric value, integral bounds or units, that the four checks compare directly; it is model_required when earning the point also depends on reading prose, a verbal claim, a graphical criterion, an implied or inferred choice, a step count, or a label naming a quantity in words, none of which any of the four checks perform.
